name: Titan Kogyo ,Ltd.
summary: Titan Kogyo, Ltd. is a Japanese manufacturer of industrial chemicals. Its products include ultrafine titanium oxide, in anatase and rutile forms, for UV-blocking cosmetics, protective films and heat stabilizers for rubber and plastics, titanium dioxide and iron oxide for cosmetic pigments, and electro-conductive inorganic oxides. Dating from 1936, it has its headquarters in Ube, Japan.
